actions.description: The ego vehicle travels forward along the wet city-center street at a moderate speed; two small bags are visible ahead resting still on the wet road in the calm air.

The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03, treating the small resting bags as obstacles.

The vehicle is fully stopped from the very start of this segment and remains completely stationary for the final 2 seconds; the small bags stay still on the wet road just a few meters ahead; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

From 0:01 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily, treating the small resting bags as obstacles. By 0:03 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. Around 0:01 the engine note drops sharply and a brief hard-braking sound is audible as the vehicle decelerates abruptly. The air is calm with no wind noise. By 0:02 the tire noise falls to near silence and, from 0:02 to 0:05, a low idle rumble and soft rain patter dominate while the bags rest silently on the wet road.
